description_en: Retrieves the storage details of each storage medium for a specific Lindorm instance
description_zh: 获取某个具体的Lindorm实例下各个存储介质的存储详情
kebab_example: aliyun hitsdb get-lindorm-fs-used-detail --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-id ld-xxxx --api-version 2020-06-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetLindormFsUsedDetail

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the instance. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/426062.html operation to obtain the region ID
parameters.help_zh: 实例所属的地域ID，可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/426062.html接口获取
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/426069.html operation to obtain the instance ID
parameters.name: instance_id

LStorageUsageList.description_en: The storage details with categorization by storage medium. This field is the authoritative source for storage details when the underlying storage engine version is >= 4.1.9
LStorageUsageList.description_zh: 底层存储引擎版本>=4.1.9 以后，存储详情展示以这个字段为准，按照存储介质进行分类

items.description_en: The storage details of a specific storage medium type
items.description_zh: 某种存储介质类型的存储详情

Capacity.description_en: The total storage capacity of this storage medium type. Unit: bytes
Capacity.description_zh: 该存储介质类型下，存储总容量，单位：byte

DiskType.description_en:
The storage type of the cluster. Valid values:
StandardCloudStorage: standard cloud storage.
PerformanceCloudStorage: performance cloud storage.
CapacityCloudStorage: capacity cloud storage.
LocalSsdStorage: local SSD.
LocalHddStorage: local HDD.
LocalEbsStorage: local cloud storage
DiskType.description_zh:
集群存储类型。可能值：
StandardCloudStorage：标准型云存储。
PerformanceCloudStorage：性能型云存储。
CapacityCloudStorage：容量型云存储。
LocalSsdStorage：本地SSD盘。
LocalHddStorage：本地HDD盘。
LocalEbsStorage：本地云存储
